notes.title: 0.3.4 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Fixed the issue where settings were not applied when no microphone was plugged in.
Added Vulkan and DirectX 12 support. Default still will be DirectX 11
Fixed Osman drag animation not working while emoting.

notes.title: 0.3.3 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Fixed game crashing at the start for some people.
Added settings for camera effects, leaning and view bobbing toggle for accessibility.
Fixed a stuck position on first map.

notes.title: ROADMAP & BUGFIX
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/15b9be94b7d3691c3d6d2dbe077842dff1e79d6f.png

Episode 3: Seagate
We would like to inform you that we have started working on the 3rd episode. Although we cannot say an exact date, we aim to release it in the first quarter of 2025. 🦜🏴‍☠️

Bugfixes

 Removed presents since it was temporary for the new year. Other new year stuff will be available for a little while. You can return to the presents branch from steam betas named "presents". But that version will not be updated.
 Fixed deactivating mines didn't show for clients.
 Fixed mines exploding constantly for some reason.

notes.title: 🚨MINOR UPDATE 0.3.0🚨
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES

 Added Steam Cloud integration.
 Added head bob toggle setting.
 Fixed players wearing boxing gloves like an item.
 Fixed weird things happening when you return to lobby after changing floors.
 Fixed loading times taking longer when changing floors.
 Better player controls after getting hit with a bottle.
 Fixed getting stuck on loading screen if disconnected.
 Removed Zorti plushie ads since we didn't reach the threshold :')
 Fixed snow effect stuck on screen after ending an emote.

notes.title: 🚨⛄ NEW YEAR UPDATE ⛄🚨
notes.notes:
LETS MAKE ZORTI REAL!
Plushie Donate Link: https://www.makeship.com/petitions/zorti

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/3ac011422b6c0987106315b6d653420cfe80d6f8.png
UPDATE 0.2.7
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/95ec143ec8009d3645d470ee60f61e7f710734d9.gif
The Christmas Holiday:

 You will find the lobby full of christmas decorations! Also don't forget to press alt + 3 on the snow!
 Many things in levels are adjusted so they suit the christmas theme.
 Added christmas gifts to all episodes. Random things will happen when you open them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/1852f9f232e9abee2969afd33b70d3c9ed2f4b3b.gif
Added The Chaos Slider.

 This is a lever that sets the chaos value for your next playthrough. 
 It tweaks spawn times, monster values and many other things!
 Since this breaks the game in many ways, you can't play a level with chaos value before finishing it once.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/1a1c42c05c4e9acf9bfc158dadeffd9d0ac1901b.gif
Added the Boomerang.

 This is an item that comes back to you. Any items it touched will also be picked up.
 Be careful with it though, since it is dangerous.
 See how it interacts with other things in the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/51cae7305329a217b16b7a9b40675940b1101b40.gif

 Added the two robots that Telerick is talking about.
 Now you can't bring down the net before the mudur event.
 Now host can force players back to level selection lobby.
 Fixed mines sometimes not triggering.
 Fixed getting stuck on collision in a cinematic in second level.
 Fixed sanity post process not correctly working on first level.
 Now zoomies will be affected by Mudur and mines.
 Adjusted Mudur's disabled texture so it is more clear when it happens.
 Adjusted LODs for many models so they don't popup very clearly.
 Now mine explosions can be chained.
 Fixed light probes not updating when active scene is changed. (Black items and ultra bright main menu)

notes.title: 🚨MINOR UPDATE 0.2.5🚨
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/61cf1a7d310a438b720270c91ddc15e512d17923.png

🚨PATCH NOTES

Added Direct IP connection and LAN connection. Port is 7777.
Now everybody can't die to one explosion, there is always one survivor. (Except when you are playing solo)
Now Osman pulls you toward him with a ground pound if it can't reach you.
Fixed skinwalkers sound levels not matching the players sound levels.
Fixed UI stuck on "Waiting For Other Players to Skip"
Fixed cinematics stuck on black screen.
We made it so you can play instruments on the concert zone before and after the concert.
Adjusted some no-instrument zones.
Adjusted the lighting for the ritual room so it is easer to see where the code is.
"Music improves mental health" signs are not lying anymore.
Now you can't pause the instruments while on the concert.
Fixed the CaRtOoNz bug.
Fixed low framerates or frame drops causing players to fling themselves out of map. Yeah weird shit...
Fixed Osman glitching when thrown a bottle to the face.
Fixed chat UI being active in main menu.
Fixed occlusion for some walls.
Fixed some spawn points for Mi and Zoomies.
Fixed being able to activate the turnstiles from behind.
Fixed multiple Osmans spawning if you return to the first floor too many times.
Fixed other mines not working when at least one is deactivated.
Now you get the hint reminder every 5 items you pick up.

and many more technical things...

notes.title: 🚨MINOR UPDATE 0.2.3🚨
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/8da0cb3cab3f8b16ecbb28785f9d778d2a4422ac.png

HOME SWEET HOME
We made some changes to Zortagene upon your request. Thanks to the changes we made, Zortagene is easier than before. 🐢

We have given a good beating to the creatures that constantly harass you. We have also made many changes to prevent you from reaching the end of the Zortagene and losing. 💀

We hope these changes give you a better gaming experience.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/df619bc40ab6ba9cb0fbdc7e3a8b4a9a9596586c.gif

IS THAT ALL?
We fixed silly deaths and possible bugs. We don't want to prevent chaos completely.

We aim to keep it as consistent as possible. In this process, we take into account the feedback on our discord server. We care about what you want in our game.
Our Community Discord Server


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/f94098ff7e1a2c0adffc136efb03b8e2b65379af.gif

WHAT IS IT THAT I HEAR?

Music is one of the subjects we care most about. We aimed to make music that people can listen to in daily life, rather than just generic music that plays in the background while playing the game.

With this update, we fixed some bugs in the musics in the game. The concert part is one of the most important.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/466897902402566514477f49a9f29f0595101b6b.gif

🚨PATCH NOTES

 Added ability to kick players out of lobby.
 Added cooldowns to some UI noises.
 More things can now be punched with the boxing gloves.
 Fixed Osman dragging the player at absurd positions.
 You will now start episode 2 looking at the direction that you have to go.
 Fixed getting stuck out of the elevator in Episode 2.
 Now there is a way to deactivate a land mine :)
 Fixed the lighting issues with the hint signs.
 Once the concert starts, instruments will be teleported back to the concert zone.
 Episode 1: Floor 2 Factory nerfed.
 Episode 1: Floor 3 Escape Garage HUGE nerfed, so now my granny can pass that level easily...
 Rat chase music increased
 Many fixed unlisted here...

and many more technical things...

notes.title: EPISODE 2: YOZGAT MINOR UPDATE | MANY BUG FIXES
notes.notes: We detected many errors in the new Yozgat episode and tried to fix as many as possible.

notes.title: EPISODE 2: YOZGAT UPDATE
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/36512e833df063f95e2c4c74d3e81c9e8d6476c9.png

If you think something is gonna work , the chances are that it is probably gonna work. So get creative when interacting with enemies and items!

We’ve added an exciting new map called Yozgat.
This is a dark and vast terrain filled with unique and terrifying creatures. As you try to escape their clutches, you’ll experience moments of pure fear, but also incredible fun! 🐢

What's new?

 New Map.
 New characters.
 New items.
 New mechanics.
 Many bug fixes.
 Fixes for Zortagane.

Get ready for a thrilling adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 💫

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/595cd6f55e40d4f42c39e3a7dbda14ac28dcd702.png

Not just these!
We added more interesting events related to Skinwalkers.
We don't want to spoil the secret by giving spoilers. We hope that there are events that will surprise you when you see them in the game.

notes.title: 🚨 MINOR UPDATE 🚨
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45128742/c96bbb0aaf82b2e06cdfdfc5b1db833b0acf47e8.gif

Localization and languages

 Fixed some typos in all languages.
 Added in spanish.


We worked on making you play the game better...

 Fixed the echo effect remaining on players' voices after falling into holes
 Many of the unclear areas where you need to progress in the game have been clarified.
 Reduced the spawn rate of mimic creatures.
 The error in purchasing items from vending machines has been fixed.
 The settings menu has been made more functional.
 Sound detectors (ZORTO) have been heavily nerfed. They can no longer be heard from a distance and a time period has been added before they can work again.
 Fixed a lot of collision bugs.
 Fixed monsters getting stuck while walking.
 Fixed Dexter's walking error after being scared.
 Ambient sound bugs have been fixed.
 Character story music has been fixed.
 Noise pollution in the game has been prevented to a large extent.
 Errors related to the number of players in the cinematic have been fixed.
 Added hidden antis to creatures.
 Spider mimics can now be kicked. All you have to do is walk on it.

notes.title: 🚨 FIRST DAY PATCH 🚨
notes.notes:
In this first episode, you will encounter other creatures while trying to escape from the factory.

Improvements and bug fixes

 Fixed items not working when exiting and re-entering the game.
 Notes and some environment details have been localized to all other supported languages.
 Holes have been added to the map. Thus, moving around the place became more difficult. You can also have fun moments by pushing your friends into holes.
 Some lighting bugs fixed
 Dexter's chance of appearing has been reduced
 The chance of Skinwalker appearing has been reduced
 The chance of ManSlender appearing has been reduced
 Jimmy's key was moved to a much more prominent location
 The saw in the factory was moved to a much more prominent place
 Important items were made shiny
 Important notes highlighted
 Fixed bugs when using Zorti
